body_markdown:
RADwood has always been about recognizing and celebrating the cars and culture of the 1980s and ’90s. The events keep getting bigger and better, and last Saturday’s show, held at the Gold Bar Hangar in Alameda, California, was the biggest yet, with more than 10,000 attendees and nearly 150 vehicles on display. By design, three of those vehicles are now for sale on Hagerty Marketplace. You might already be familiar with them…


A month ago, Hagerty launched a six-part series on its YouTube channel called *[Radwood Build Challenge](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRHZ8Ct8cfU)* , in which three popular automotive personalities—[Larry Chen](https://www.instagram.com/larry_chen_foto/) ,[Vin Anatra](https://www.instagram.com/vin_tra/?hl=en) , and[Mike Burroughs](https://www.instagram.com/stanceworks/) —would compete to create the raddest RADwood build, to be voted on by attendees at the event. The prize: $100,000, with half going to the builder and half going to the charity of his choice. Each had the same purchasing budget. Chen snagged a[JDM 1996 Honda Accord SiR](https://www.hagerty.com/marketplace/auction/1996-Honda-Accord/4b6dcacc-afe9-418a-ad6f-515cea3971fb) , Anatra chose a[1994 Chevy Silverado 3500 Crew Cab Dually](https://www.hagerty.com/marketplace/auction/1994-Chevrolet-Silverado/79ac380e-0879-4677-9e49-43ddf0e4d855) , and Burroughs went with a[1989 Lotus Esprit SE Turbo](https://www.hagerty.com/marketplace/auction/1989-Lotus-Esprit/2be3402d-48d8-4b03-8eb6-d5bd05a55fec) .


## 1996 Honda Accord SiR


Hagerty Marketplace


Chen imported the Accord from Japan with the idea of turning it into a car you might have seen in the Japanese Touring Car Championship 30 years ago. It started life with a high-compression 2.2-liter VTEC four-cylinder, which he had rebuilt with forged internals and a massaged head with bigger valves, then topped with a GReddy turbocharger blowing out a wastegate through the hood. It wears Mugen bumpers and side skirts, with a full 7-Eleven livery, while the inside is finished with Sparco racing seats and pedals, a billet shifter, and a Haltech digital dash. The listing notes that, due to the modifications, the car may not pass emissions in some areas.

## 1994 Chevrolet Silverado 3500 Crew Cab Dually


Hagerty Marketplace


Anatra’s burly GMT400-generation Silverado is about as far from a JDM Honda as it gets. To complete the build, he sourced custom parts and even bits from flea markets. He dropped the frame 10 inches, shaved the tailgate, and widened the bedside flares before fitting a 4-inch steel-cowl hood above the 454-cubic-inch V-8. A long Lund sun visor, boomerang antenna, 20-inch wheels, and custom red-and-blue graphics complete the look outside, while the inside is decked out with new cloth upholstery, a billet shift lever and steering wheel, a double-DIN stereo system, and a footprint gas pedal. He notes that the catalytic converters have been removed, overspray is present, and the front wheels rub.

## 1989 Lotus Esprit SE Turbo


Hagerty Marketplace


Finally, Burroughs’ Lotus benefits from a custom H&R coilover suspension. It sits on fantastic-looking HRE 935 three-piece wheels poking out of fabricated fender flares. The Esprit’s turbocharged 2.2-liter four-cylinder and five-speed manual transmission were serviced, and Burroughs built a custom stainless steel exhaust for the car. Its vinyl wrap is Sony VHS–inspired, and the interior is finished with Recaro seats and steering wheel, as well as powder-coated aluminum floor plates. The Lotus is described as temperamental and very much still a project, with more work required to prevent overheating and tire rubbing, among other issues.

At RADwood, the people voted[Chen’s Accord as the winner](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDfICeVa4Rw) , and he donated $50,000 to the[RPM Foundation](https://www.rpm.foundation/) , which supports education and training for the next generation of automotive technicians, restorers, and craftspeople through grants and scholarships.


With less than a week left in the auction for all three vehicles, bidding for Chen’s Accord currently sits at $15,500; Anatra’s Silverado is at $10,501, and Burroughs’ Esprit is bid to $20,140.
